title: Contemporary R&B
tagline: Soul-rooted vocals shaped by modern rhythm, production, and pop forms.
summary: Contemporary R&B carries the vocal focus and emotional directness of rhythm and blues into modern production. Its sound has shifted with each generation, incorporating hip-hop beats, synthesizers, electronic textures, and pop songwriting while retaining expressive singing at its core. The genre's breadth reflects how artists continually reshape the relationship between voice and groove.

pillars.name: Janet Jackson
pillars.why: Janet Jackson connected precise pop songwriting, dance production, and R&B vocal phrasing across influential albums.

pillars.name: Mary J. Blige
pillars.why: Mary J. Blige brought a distinctive combination of soul singing and hip-hop production to contemporary R&B.

pillars.name: Aaliyah
pillars.why: Aaliyah's understated vocals and innovative production helped shape a sleek, influential 1990s R&B sound.
